blocks.text: Condo buildings in Sunnyside Park Surrey
Semiahmoo Estates (also recorded as Semiahmoo Community Estates) — 2239 152 Street

The sub-area's established apartment-condo building, in Sunnyside Park Surrey per the building directory and MLS records. Construction: frame wood with brick and stucco exterior. Year built — conflict IN SOURCES: the building directory states 1991. Restrictions (building directory, secondary source): age restrictions, pets not allowed, rentals not allowed — the rental line is void since Nov 24, 2022; listings describe it as a well-managed 55+ community. Directory amenities: club house, elevator, exercise centre, in-suite laundry, recreation centre, wheelchair access; listings add a social lounge, workshop and library, 1.5 blocks from the Semiahmoo Trail.
Odyssey by Forge Properties — 2620 152 Street and 2635 King George Boulevard

The sub-area's new apartment-condo project: two 4-storey wood-frame low-rises, 132 condominiums, between 152 Street and King George Boulevard in the Sunnyside Park neighbourhood. Listings record the buildings as built 2025, wood-frame construction, with units at both the 2620 152 Street and 2635 King George Boulevard addresses.
South Point Walk — 2960 151 Street (King George Corridor edge)
Built 2018 (current listing, apartment/condo, freehold strata); the listing describes the building's largest 2-bedroom-plus-den apartment.
Where it sits and what to know here

items.t: Where the condo stock concentrates: one tight node — the 152 Street corridor at 22nd–24th Avenue, where the sub-area's two apartment-condo buildings (Semiahmoo Estates at 2239 152 Street and Odyssey at 2620 152 Street / 2635 King George Boulevard) stand a few blocks apart, plus the King George Corridor edge building at 2960 151 Street. The rest of the sub-area's attached stock is townhouses and the balance is detached houses.

Anchors in the node: Semiahmoo Shopping Centre at 1711 152 Street; Peninsula Village Shopping Centre at 15355 24 Avenue (at King George Boulevard); Peace Arch Hospital at 15521 Russell Avenue, White Rock, is the nearest hospital (Fraser Health). Transit: route 321 runs Surrey Central Station to White Rock Centre / White Rock South via King George Boulevard and 152 Street.
Frame roads: 148 Street, 152 Street, 20 Avenue, 24 Avenue and King George Boulevard serve the area.

The whole in-sub-area apartment stock stands within a few blocks on one street. Semiahmoo Estates (2239 152 Street) and Odyssey (2620 152 Street) are both on 152 Street between 22nd and 26th Avenue — a buyer who wants an apartment condo in Sunnyside Park is choosing between a 1990/1991 55+ wood-frame building and a 2025 wood-frame project, with nothing verified in between.

Surrey has a new Official Community Plan. The Surrey 2050 OCP (Bylaw No. 21900) received final adoption on June 15, 2026 per a City corporate report — any older page or document citing the PlanSurrey 2013 OCP (Bylaw No. 18020) as current is out of date, including for the Semiahmoo Town Centre designations beside this sub-area.
Attached product outsold detached here by a wide margin in September 2026. One month is not a trend, but it is the segment context a Sunnyside seller is pricing into.

Sunnyside Acres is the sub-area's back yard. Sunnyside Acres Urban Forest Park (2598 144 Street) is a roughly 140-hectare second-growth forest with about 4 kilometres of trails including the Wally Ross universal access trail, and the Semiahmoo Trail runs through this part of South Surrey — Semiahmoo Estates listings put the building 1.5 blocks from the trail.

The recreation centre and pool are on 20th and 17th Avenues, not at the shopping centre. South Surrey Recreation and Arts Centre is at 14601 20 Ave and the South Surrey Indoor Pool at 14655 17 Avenue; Semiahmoo Library is at 1815 152nd Street.

A 100-unit condo site at 2301–2337 152 Street has planning history but is not a building. Listing material for the court-ordered sale of 2301 152 Street describes an approved-at-third-reading 100-unit, 6-storey mixed-use condo site at 152 Street and King George Boulevard. It is a development site, not completed stock.

blocks.text: Townhome complexes in Sunnyside Park
(2) Highgrove's age status conflicts between listings — one states "no age restrictions," another describes a unit as a "55+ semidetached townhome".
Bishop's Green — 2533 152 Street. Strata

A gated townhouse complex of duplex-style rancher townhouses with walkout basements, a clubhouse, exercise centre and guest suite in listing amenity records, steps from the Semiahmoo Trail system. Listings describe a "55+ gated community" / "highly sought after 55+ gated community of Bishop's Green" — a published 55+ description; the registered bylaw itself is proved only on the Form B. Tenure evidence: current listings record monthly strata fees for its units, and units are classified Townhouse in Sunnyside Park Surrey. Year built: listings vary by unit — 1991 and 1992 both appear — carried as 1991–1992, phased/early-1990s in listing terms; confirm the unit's year on the strata plan.
St. Martin's Lane — 15020 27A Avenue. Strata

Polygon's gated townhouse complex of half-duplex rancher townhouses with walkout basements, in-floor radiant heat and a clubhouse in listing amenity records, built 1995. Listings describe a "55+ gated community" — published description only; the registered bylaw is proved on the Form B.
Highgrove — 15055 20 Avenue. Strata

Unit count: a directory listing header records a 22-unit development (secondary source). Year built — conflict: listings record 1999 and 2001 for different units. Do not publish Highgrove as a 55+ complex, or as age-free, until the registered bylaws are read on the Form B.
Orchard Park — 15121 19 Avenue. Strata

A townhouse complex whose subdivision name in MLS records is Orchard Park; a current listing classifies its units as Townhouse in Sunnyside Park Surrey, built 1987, duplex-style 2-storey townhomes backing onto greenspace and a walking path, with monthly strata fees recorded for the unit checked.
Where it sits and what to know here

items.t: Where the townhouse stock concentrates: the 152 Street corridor and its side streets — Bishop's Green at 2533 152 St, Highgrove at 15055 20 Ave, Orchard Park at 15121 19 Ave, and St. Martin's Lane at 15020 27A Ave at the south edge as MLS places it — plus the King George Corridor-filed Peninsula Village at 2500 152 St documented in but not counted.

Schools (SD36; Ministry-listed names only): Semiahmoo Secondary, 1785 - 148 Street, is physically in this sub-area per its SD36 page. T. Thrift Elementary; Secondary = Semiahmoo Secondary (SD36 School Locator, run 2026-11-01). SD36 schools are elementary Kindergarten to Grade 7 and secondary Grades 8 to 12.

Parks and recreation: Bakerview Park, 1845 - 154 Street, has Sunnyside Community Hall, a garden, playground, baseball diamonds and a soccer field; Sunnyside Acres Urban Forest Park, 2598 144 Street, is a roughly 140-hectare second-growth forest with about 4 kilometres of trails including the Wally Ross universal access trail, and the Semiahmoo Trail runs through this part of South Surrey; South Surrey Recreation and Arts Centre is at 14601 - 20 Ave and the South Surrey Indoor Pool at 14655 17 Avenue; Semiahmoo Library is at 1815 - 152nd Street.

Shopping and health: Semiahmoo Shopping Centre, 1711 152 Street, is the named centre beside this sub-area; Peninsula Village Shopping Centre is at 15355 24 Avenue at King George Boulevard. Peace Arch Hospital, 15521 Russell Avenue, White Rock, is the nearest hospital (Fraser Health).

Market context (SnapStats, combined segment only — never a townhome-only figure): the sub-area recorded Detached inventory 46 / sales 3 / sales ratio 7% and Condos & Townhomes inventory 28 / sales 9 / sales ratio 32% in September 2026 — attached product carried this sub-area that month.

Strata diligence — the Form B regime (all 4 counted complexes are strata): Strata Property Act s. 59 — the Form B states the lot's monthly strata fees, amounts owing, approved special levies still payable, the CRF balance and an insurance summary, with the rules, current budget, any Rental Disclosure Statement and the most recent depreciation report attached; provided within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page. For Bishop's Green, St. Martin's Lane and Highgrove the Form B is also where any 55+ bylaw is actually proved — listing descriptions are not proof.

Presales (REDMA) — live here via Elisa: a presale buyer must receive the developer's disclosure statement (REDMA s. 18, deposits in trust) and has a 7-day rescission period from the later of signing or acknowledging it (REDMA s. 21). Apply that frame to any Elisa at Sunnyside Park purchase.

The corridor's filing split hides half the stock from a single-sub-area search. Peninsula Village (2500 152 St, King George Corridor filing) and Bishop's Green (2533 152 St, Sunnyside Park filing) stand a few blocks apart on the same street, both gated 55+-described townhouse complexes — a buyer searching only one sub-area's page misses the other.

Highgrove's own listings argue with each other about its age rule. "No age restrictions" in one listing, "55+ semidetached townhome" in another, for the same 15055 20 Avenue complex — the clearest local example of why an age claim is proved on the Form B's registered bylaws, never from listing copy.

Surrey has a new Official Community Plan, and older citations are stale. The Surrey 2050 OCP (Bylaw No. 21900) received final adoption on June 15, 2026 — any older page or feature sheet citing the PlanSurrey 2013 OCP (Bylaw No. 18020) as current is out of date, including for the Semiahmoo Town Centre designations beside this sub-area.

The newest townhouse supply here is a 31-unit presale across from the park the sub-area is named for. Elisa at Sunnyside Park (2669 154 St, by Hive) is sited across from Sunnyside Park at 15455 26 Avenue — the City park that shares the sub-area's name, a separate thing from both the sub-area and from Sunnyside Acres Urban Forest (2598 144 Street, roughly 140 hectares, about 4 km of trails). Three different "Sunnyside" references meet on one townhouse search.

The recreation centre and pool are not at the shopping centre. South Surrey Recreation and Arts Centre is at 14601 - 20 Ave and the South Surrey Indoor Pool at 14655 17 Avenue; Semiahmoo Library is at 1815 - 152nd Street — the amenity cluster for the 152 Street townhouses is the 20th/17th Avenue civic block, not Semiahmoo Shopping Centre.

blocks.text: Where it sits and what to know here

items.t: Municipality: City of Surrey, BC — Sunnyside is in South Surrey, in the Semiahmoo peninsula area between 16 Avenue and 24 Avenue.

Search / alternate names: "Sunnyside" (City and local usage); "Sunnyside Park" (board name); "South Surrey" generally; "Semiahmoo" (the secondary school and town centre name) — but not "Sunnyside Heights."

Roads: 148 Street, 152 Street, 20 Avenue, 24 Avenue and King George Boulevard serve the area. Transit: route 321 runs Surrey Central Station to White Rock Centre / White Rock South via King George Boulevard and 152 Street, stopping at White Rock Centre near this area.

Schools: Surrey Schools (SD36) catchments are address-based through the district's School Locator. Semiahmoo Secondary, 1785 - 148 Street, is physically in this sub-area per its SD36 page. Thrift Elementary / Semiahmoo Secondary (locator range 1739–1785 148 St; SD36 School Locator, mybaragar.com, run 2026-11-01). The Ministry-vs-locator punctuation difference — "H T Thrift" vs "H.T. SD36 schools are elementary Kindergarten to Grade 7 and secondary Grades 8 to 12.

Semiahmoo Town Centre Plan: the plan was approved by Council and later updated to align with the King George Boulevard Bus Rapid Transit and the Surrey 2050 OCP designations; the plan area, 16 Avenue to 24 Avenue from Martin Drive to Earl Marriott Secondary School, borders this sub-area.

Sunnyside Acres is the sub-area's back yard — and a different "Sunnyside" from the park the sub-area is named for. Sunnyside Acres Urban Forest Park (2598 144 Street) is a roughly 140-hectare second-growth forest with about 4 km of trails including the Wally Ross universal access trail.

faq.a: Two in-sub-area buildings — Semiahmoo Estates (2239 152 Street) and Odyssey (2620 152 Street / 2635 King George Boulevard) — plus the King George Corridor edge building South Point Walk (2960 151 Street). Everything else attached in the sub-area is townhouses (Peninsula Village, Bishop's Green) or detached houses.
faq.q: How many apartment-condo buildings are actually in Sunnyside Park?

faq.a: No. Peninsula Village (2500 152 Street) is a gated townhouse complex built in 1993 — townhouse strata lots with a clubhouse and a private gate to the Peninsula Village Shopping Centre.
faq.q: Is Peninsula Village a condo building?

faq.a: Rentals: a long-term rental-restriction bylaw has been unenforceable since November 24, 2022 anywhere in BC, so the directory's "rentals not allowed" line is old bylaw text. Pets: pet bylaws remain enforceable, and the directory records pets not allowed — read the registered bylaws. Age: the directory records age restrictions and listings describe a 55+ community; a 55+ bylaw is the one age bylaw BC law still allows.
faq.q: The directory says Semiahmoo Estates bans rentals and pets. What is actually enforceable?

faq.a: The sources conflict: the building directory states 1991.
faq.q: How old is Semiahmoo Estates, exactly?

faq.a: Odyssey by Forge Properties is two 4-storey wood-frame low-rises with 132 condominiums between 152 Street and King George Boulevard; current listings record units as built 2025 at both 2620 152 Street and 2635 King George Boulevard, so the buildings are complete and trading as resales/developer sales, not as a future presale.
faq.q: What is Odyssey, and is it finished?

faq.a: Provincially, a younger spouse or partner of a resident who meets the age requirement (or holds a legacy exemption) is exempt, as are live-in caregivers and legacy residents (SPA ss. 123.1/123.2, Reg 7.01 as expanded May 1, 2023). Peninsula Village listings next door state the common local form expressly — "One person 55+" — but each complex's own bylaw wording must be confirmed in its Form B.
faq.q: Do both of us have to be 55 to live in Bishop's Green or St. Martin's Lane?

faq.a: No. Sunnyside Heights is a different Grandview Heights plan area by 168 Street, 24 Avenue and Highway 99; "Sunnyside Park" is also a City park at 15455 26 Avenue, distinct from the sub-area. Mixing the names misstates the location and the plan rules.
faq.q: Is Sunnyside Park the same as Sunnyside Heights?

faq.a: Thrift Elementary / Semiahmoo Secondary. It applies to that address only.
